claims.head: One power play bites, one doesn’t
claims.body: On the power play, Florida is near the top of the league, but Buffalo is near the bottom. Every penalty the Sabres take could cost them. These two hand each other plenty of power plays, so special teams should get a real say.

BUF.head: The Sabres start a half-step ahead
BUF.body: Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Panthers can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

FLA.head: Close, but the Sabres have the slight edge
FLA.body: Buffalo has been out-chancing opponents lately and has home-ice advantage. The Panthers’ best way to tip it is a penalty kill that holds up.
